# WZ PDF

> A free, fully client-side PDF viewer and editor. View, annotate, edit text,
> manage pages, present fullscreen, and export to multiple formats — all in the
> browser, with no backend and no file upload. The document is processed
> entirely on the user's device, so it never leaves their machine.

WZ PDF runs as a web app and as a Windows desktop app (Electron). The UI is
available in English and Korean (auto-detected from the browser/OS locale; can
be forced with `?lang=en` or `?lang=ko`).

## Key features

- View: single page, two-page spread, grid overview, and a fullscreen
  presentation mode (USB-clicker friendly, touchpad swipe, click-to-advance).
- Annotate (Editor mode): preset/image stamps, hand-drawn signatures, and
  full-page text watermarks — baked into the exported PDF. Korean text is
  supported via an embedded Noto Sans KR font.
- Text: a real selectable/copyable text layer; in Editor mode, double-click to
  edit text via an inline overlay.
- Page management: drag to reorder, insert blank pages, insert pages from
  another PDF, delete pages, and merge.
- Export: annotated PDF, a self-contained HTML viewer, page images (ZIP), and a
  standalone Viewer EXE (desktop build).
- Privacy: no server, no upload. All processing happens in the browser.

## Technology

React, Konva (canvas annotation layer), pdf.js (rendering & text), pdf-lib
(export), and Electron (desktop). An optional Model Context Protocol (MCP)
server lets AI agents perform PDF operations programmatically.
